sinopsis.es: Adaptación libre de la novela homónima de Joseph Conrad, cuenta la misión de un agente de policía de Río de Janeiro, Marlon, en busca del Capitán Kurtz, desaparecido en las afueras de la ciudad en misteriosas circunstancias.
sinopsis.en: Rio de Janeiro, near future. Marlow is a police officer assigned to a mission to find Captain Kurtz, a famous policeman who went missing in mysterious circumstances. Marlow has to do his mission in a boat, undertaking a dangerous journey through the outskirts of Rio de Janeiro.
